decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The construction of a basement extension incorporating two light wells to the front and one to the side of the property, as shown on drawing numbers LBR641-02A Rev. A Sheets 1 & 2 (Amended plans) received 10 April 2006 and LBR641-01 Sheets 1 & 2 received 22 February 2006, would by reason of its size and position, satisfactorily maintain the existing street scene and amenity of neighbours and also preserve and enhance the appearance and character of Chiswick House Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The building shall not be used any time other than for a single dwelling. The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling.
Condition : 5 - The basement rooms shall not be used as a bedroom, dining room, living room, kitchen or other habitable room.

Condition : 6 - No excavation, demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 7:30am to 5:00pm on Monday to Friday and 8:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Creation of a basement extension incorporating two light wells to the front of the property and one to the side (Chiswick House Conservation Area)
